stage_b_reviewed_content.statement:
Convention: a ring is commutative with $1$; an $R$-algebra is associative, unital and central over $R$.

Let $R$ be a ring. A functor $F : \mathcal{A} \to \mathcal{B}$
of differential graded categories over $R$ induces functors
$\text{Comp}(\mathcal{A}) \to \text{Comp}(\mathcal{B})$
and $K(\mathcal{A}) \to K(\mathcal{B})$.
conclusions:
A functor $F : \mathcal{A} \to \mathcal{B}$
of differential graded categories over $R$ induces functors
$\text{Comp}(\mathcal{A}) \to \text{Comp}(\mathcal{B})$
and $K(\mathcal{A}) \to K(\mathcal{B})$.

reason: The pinned proof for the induced degree-zero and homotopy-category functors is simply 'Omitted.' No proof is present to screen.

stage_b_reviewed_content.statement:
Let $F : \mathcal{B} \to \mathcal{B}'$ be an additive functor between
additive categories. Then $F$ induces a functor of differential
graded categories
$$
F : \text{Comp}^{dg}(\mathcal{B}) \to \text{Comp}^{dg}(\mathcal{B}')
$$ with the standard Hom-complex differential
inducing the usual functors on the category of complexes and the
homotopy categories.
hypotheses: F:B→B′ is an additive functor between additive categories.
conclusions: Termwise application of F gives a dg functor between the dg categories of complexes and hence the ordinary functor on complexes and the induced homotopy-category functor.

reason: Pinned source explicitly omits the proof that additive functors extend to dg categories of complexes; no written proof is available for screening.

stage_b_reviewed_content.statement:
Let $\varphi : (A, \text{d}) \to (E, \text{d})$ be a homomorphism of
differential graded algebras. Then $\varphi$ induces a functor of differential
graded categories
$$
F :
\text{Mod}^{dg}_{(E, \text{d})}
\longrightarrow
\text{Mod}^{dg}_{(A, \text{d})}
$$ inducing obvious restriction functors
on the categories of differential graded modules and homotopy categories.
hypotheses: φ:(A,d)→(E,d) is a morphism of dg algebras.
conclusions: Restriction of scalars along φ is a dg functor from dg E-modules to dg A-modules, and induces functors on their degree-zero and homotopy categories.

reason: Pinned source explicitly omits the restriction-of-scalars dg-functor proof; this must remain deferred rather than treated as audited.
